Advanced Skin Treatments Achieving radiant, healthy skin often requires a little more than your typical skincare routine. At Skin Health Medi Spa in Dover, we offer a range of advanced treatments designed to target your unique concerns, rejuvenate your appearance, and keep your skin feeling fresh and youthful. Whether you’re struggling with fine lines, hyperpigmentation, or just want a glowing complexion, our specialized treatments have you covered. Lamprobe Procedure : This noninvasive, speedy treatment targets and eliminates skin irregularities, such as skin tags, cherry angiomas, milia, sebaceous hyperplasia, and clogged pores. Using the latest radiofrequency technology allows for immediate results and minimal discomfort. Microdermabrasion : Gently exfoliate away dead skin cells to reveal smoother, brighter skin underneath. Microdermabrasion is perfect for reducing fine lines, lightening dark spots, and achieving an even skin texture. Collagen Induction Therapy (Microneedling) : Stimulate your skin’s natural healing processes to boost collagen and elastin production, giving you a firmer, smoother, and rejuvenated look. Microneedling can reduce the appearance of acne scars, fine lines, and uneven skin tone. At Skin Health Medi Spa, we offer both traditional and radiofrequency (RF) microneedling. Chemical Peels : Experience the power of chemical exfoliation to shed dull, damaged skin. Our chemical peels range from light to medium depth. We tailor peels to treat your skin concerns—whether it’s acne, sun damage, or fine lines—leaving you with a fresher, more even complexion. IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) : Address pigmentation, age spots, and redness with IPL therapy. This treatment evens out skin tone and reduces the appearance of sun damage for a clear, luminous complexion. Spend Your Day at The Spa You deserve to treat yourself. Escape into a day of indulgence with our luxurious spa treatments. We design each of our options to soothe your body, rejuvenate your skin, and restore your spirit. Whether you’re preparing for a special event or simply need a break from the everyday, we offer experiences that are as transformative as they are relaxing. Facials & Peels Give your skin care that goes beyond the surface. At our med spa in Dover, your provider tailors treatment to your skin type and concerns, leaving your skin refreshed, radiant, and uniquely your own. Hydrafacial : Deeply cleanse, exfoliate, and hydrate your skin with a treatment that leaves you glowing and ready to take on the world. Back “Facial” : Pamper those hard-to-reach areas with a deep-cleansing back facial, perfect for keeping your skin clear and smooth. Glo2 Facial : Revitalize your skin with oxygenation and gentle exfoliation, providing a boost in hydration and nourishment that helps you look youthful and vibrant. Chemical Peels : Ask for a peel to help address concerns such as sun damage, acne, or fine lines, revealing smoother and more even skin. Makeup Services Look and feel your best with our professional makeup services. Whether it’s your big day or just a night out, our artists are here to elevate your natural beauty. Bridal and Special Event Makeup : For your most memorable day, our experts create a timeless, picture-perfect look that lasts. Makeup Lessons : Learn the secrets to enhancing your features and achieve a professional look from our talented makeup artists. Consultations : Let us help you discover the perfect shades and techniques for your unique style with personalized guidance from our experts. Massage Therapy Relax, unwind, and let go of all unneeded stress. Our massages are all about providing you the ultimate experience in relaxation and wellness. Couples Massage : Share a bonding experience with someone you hold dear, perfect for releasing deep-seated muscle stress and creating a new memory together. Hot Stone Massage : Melt away tension with the elemental warmth of hot stones, designed to reach deeper into the dermis. Swedish Massage : Relax into gentle, flowing strokes that promote circulation, relieve stress, and provide an overall sense of relaxation. Therapeutic Massage : Relieve pain and relax with a therapeutic massage, known to help with stress, anxiety, depression, headaches, digestive issues, and injuries Deep Tissue Massage : Target deep muscle layers and stubborn knots with focused pressure to relieve chronic tension and tight muscles.
